test: Seatbelt profile under the real kernel
an app in the workspace cannot be launched outside the sandbox
mayRuntimeSkip.reason: Skips at runtime (ctx.skip) when the probe app does not launch even unconfined, so the denial would prove nothing. Whether LaunchServices opens an unsigned bundle on a hosted runner is not established; a skip is recorded, a failure is not accepted.

test: Seatbelt profile under the real kernel
the login Keychain is unreachable through the security tool
mayRuntimeSkip.reason: Skips at runtime (ctx.skip) when the host user has no readable login Keychain item to compare against. A fresh hosted runner user is not expected to have one; a skip is recorded, a failure is not accepted.

test: Seatbelt profile under the real kernel
the installed Claude Code answers its handshake from inside the profile, and the provider observes it confined
notRequired.reason: Guarded by test.skipIf(!claudeExecutable): it needs Claude Code on PATH, which a hosted macOS runner does not have, so requiring it would fail every hosted run. It still runs on a developer Mac with claude on PATH.
